from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    divider = next((('row', r) for r in range(h)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and counts[grid[r][0]] == w), None)
    if divider is None:
        divider = next(('col', c) for c in range(w)
                        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                        and counts[grid[0][c]] == h)
    if divider[0] == 'row':
        k = divider[1]
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
    else:
        k = divider[1]
        a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        b = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
